2026-chalk-whareformer.summary: Whareformer learns to associate object observations with persistent tracks using appearance and relative 3D location, including when objects temporarily leave the camera view.

2026-ma-r4dsg.summary: R4DSG writes object histories as changes relative to stable scene anchors, then retrieves compact records for questions about past locations and transitions.

2021-luo-clip4clip.summary: CLIP4Clip adapts pretrained image–text features to video retrieval by aggregating frame representations and tuning the video–text training setup.
2021-luo-clip4clip.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/foundations.md — CLIP4Clip: strong image features are already useful for clip retrieval

2021-bain-frozen-in-time.summary: Frozen in Time trains text and video encoders in a shared space using image–text and video–text pairs. Videos can be indexed before a query arrives.
2021-bain-frozen-in-time.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/foundations.md — Frozen in Time: why embeddings allow indexing to be separated from querying

2024-wang-internvideo2.summary: InternVideo2 combines video-feature distillation, multimodal contrastive learning and next-token prediction to build reusable representations for video understanding.
2024-wang-internvideo2.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/foundations.md — InternVideo2: one backbone can support several levels of the system

2026-tan-egovit.summary: EgoViT learns object-focused visual features from unlabeled egocentric clips through self-distillation, depth regularization and filtered temporal correspondence.

2026-mur-labadia-v-jepa-2-1.summary: V-JEPA 2.1 learns reusable image and video features that preserve local geometry and temporal consistency while retaining global action information.

2020-lei-tvr.summary: Provides a video-and-subtitle corpus retrieval benchmark and XML, a late-fusion model for selecting videos and localizing relevant moments.

2026-hou-eventformer.summary: Indexes event representations to retrieve candidate videos, then localizes query-relevant intervals within those candidates.

2026-lee-carve.summary: CARVE selects an evidence representation per video chunk, while V-RAGBench separates retrieval quality from answer generation.

2025-jeong-videorag.summary: VideoRAG retrieves instructional videos from a corpus and supplies selected visual evidence to an answer generator.

2026-ren-videorag.summary: VideoRAG combines a cross-video textual knowledge graph with visual segment retrieval and question-specific evidence descriptions.

2025-cao-flashmmr.summary: Introduces QV-M² and FlashMMR to retrieve several separate moments matching one natural-language query.

2024-wu-longvideobench.summary: LongVideoBench evaluates question answering about an already selected long video, with 6,678 questions covering 17 categories of referred reasoning.
2024-wu-longvideobench.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/archive.md — Benchmarks for reading a selected video

2025-fu-video-mme.summary: Video-MME evaluates video question answering across short, medium and long recordings, with separate settings for the availability of subtitles.
2025-fu-video-mme.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/archive.md — Benchmarks for reading a selected video

2024-goletto-amego.summary: AMEGO builds a reusable visual memory of hand-object interactions and activity locations, then answers queries about their timing, order and overlap.
2024-goletto-amego.spotlightReason: Inspectable interaction memory: persistent object tracks, visual features, times and locations. Complements caption retrieval with a concrete visual record of manipulated objects.

2026-liang-capmem.summary: Tests reusable caption memory against direct video QA with matched-frame controls, repeated-query cost accounting and sparse visual verification.

2025-zhang-vocal-udf.summary: VOCAL-UDF extends a video-query vocabulary by generating reusable programs or small visual models for missing predicates.

2026-rauf-hpp.summary: HPP lets a coding LLM compose video-search and perception operations in a persistent Python environment to answer questions over a recorded video.

2026-zhang-egocite.summary: EgoCITE makes memory entries understandable outside their original context and retrieves evidence according to the question's temporal intent.

2025-ye-mm-ego.summary: MM-Ego learns a coarse-to-fine video reader that scans compressed frame representations, selects relevant details and answers egocentric questions.

2026-leng-flora.summary: FLORA turns human or robot episode videos into timestamped action captions and several forms of execution-reward labels.

2024-fan-videoagent.summary: VideoAgent combines caption and object-occurrence memories with an LLM that retrieves video evidence through four tools to answer questions.

2026-choi-merit.summary: MERIT indexes short video episodes with several textual keys and expands relevant context only when a question arrives.
2026-choi-merit.spotlightReason: First practical retrieval baseline to evaluate: timestamped clips, several searchable keys, neighboring context and final answering from retrieved frames. Its simple episode design provides a useful control before adding WorldMM-style graphs.

2026-yeo-worldmm.summary: WorldMM answers long-video questions by iteratively retrieving complementary episodic, semantic, and visual memories.

2025-luo-video-rag.summary: Video-RAG augments an existing video model with question-relevant speech, visible text and object information extracted from the supplied video.

2025-yang-egolife.summary: EgoLife provides synchronized, week-long recordings of six housemates, a long-horizon QA benchmark, and an audio-visual caption memory baseline for personal assistance.

2026-chen-em2mem.summary: EM²Mem aligns captions, speech, visual evidence and provenance into shared event records before retrieval, trading more ingestion work for cheaper repeated queries.

2026-rege-egagent.summary: EGAgent combines temporal entity graphs, visual retrieval, and transcript search to answer questions about days of egocentric experience.

2026-tian-ego-r1.summary: Ego-R1 trains a small controller to search hierarchical video memories and call visual tools when a question needs finer evidence.

2026-huang-apm-bench.summary: Evaluates persistent video memory across interrupted sessions, jointly testing recall, current perception, proactive responses, missing evidence, storage and latency.

2026-chen-egomonth.summary: Tests exact episodic recall and cross-day reasoning using first-person recordings spanning 20–120 days per participant.

2026-wang-egomemreason.summary: Tests whether video memories can combine multiple observations across days to track entities, order events and infer routines.
2026-wang-egomemreason.spotlightReason: Multi-day questions require several evidence segments. Oracle-evidence controls help distinguish retrieval failure from reasoning failure, complementing S-EMBER's localization test.

2024-zhang-llovi.summary: LLoVi describes short video segments and lets an LLM answer long-video questions from those captions and intermediate summaries.

2025-wang-videotree.summary: VideoTree selects question-relevant keyframes through adaptive visual clustering, then answers from their time-ordered captions.

2024-song-moviechat.summary: MovieChat compresses visual tokens into short-term and long-term memory to read long video sequences within a limited model context.

2024-wang-videoagent.summary: Wang’s VideoAgent uses an LLM to iteratively request informative video frames through tools. It is distinct from Fan’s VideoAgent, which builds reusable caption and object memories.
2024-wang-videoagent.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/archive.md — Two different VideoAgents: active reading and reusable memory

2026-cai-cfd.summary: CFD caches video descriptions and retrieves bounded visual evidence only when a question needs details that text cannot supply.

2026-xiong-memlife.summary: MemLife writes entity-grounded episodic memories, while MemOpt trains the writer to preserve evidence that later questions can retrieve.

2018-hsieh-focus.summary: Focus divides object-class video search between inexpensive ingestion and selective expensive verification at query time.

2019-kang-blazeit.summary: BlazeIt executes declarative video queries with specialized models, sampling and selective verification instead of fully materializing expensive detector outputs.

2022-kang-tasti.summary: TASTI reuses an embedding index and a small set of expensive labels to generate proxy scores for multiple downstream queries.

2023-zhang-equi-vocal.summary: EQUI-VOCAL learns executable spatiotemporal video queries from positive and negative examples plus active user feedback.

2020-li-reducto.summary: Adapts inexpensive on-camera frame filtering to query-specific accuracy targets and changing video content.

2026-wang-directme.summary: DirectMe retrieves a pose-aware spatial scene graph to answer questions about previously observed objects relative to the user's current position.

2025-anwar-remembr.summary: ReMEmbR stores timestamped, localized video captions and retrieves them iteratively to answer questions and generate robot navigation goals.

2026-yeh-all-angles-bench.summary: All-Angles Bench diagnoses cross-view correspondence and spatial reasoning with human-checked questions, paired variants and controlled partial visibility.

2025-he-egoexobench.summary: EgoExoBench tests cross-view video reasoning, including whether an additional demonstration improves action prediction or relative skill assessment.

2024-huang-egoexolearn.summary: EgoExoLearn connects third-person demonstrations with first-person task execution through gaze, procedural annotations and human pairwise skill judgments.
2024-huang-egoexolearn.spotlightReason: Makes relative skill assessment concrete through 34,239 retained comparisons and asynchronous demonstrations. Its controls show that an expert reference alone need not improve ranking.

2022-elfeki-multi-ego.summary: Multi-DPP jointly selects important events and representative camera views from recordings made by several moving wearers.

2022-grauman-ego4d.summary: Ego4D provides diverse egocentric recordings and benchmarks for retrieving past experiences, understanding interactions and object changes, and forecasting activity.

2022-sener-assembly101.summary: Assembly101 benchmarks action understanding and mistake detection using synchronized views of toy assembly, with flexible ordering, corrections, and hand poses.

2024-grauman-ego-exo4d.summary: Ego-Exo4D pairs first-person and third-person recordings with expert critiques, procedural annotations and 3D pose to benchmark understanding of skilled human activity.
2024-grauman-ego-exo4d.spotlightReason: Foundational skilled-activity recordings with synchronized viewpoints and expert feedback. Defines useful observations and annotation formats before choosing a model.

2026-kim-ma-egoqa.summary: MA-EgoQA tests reasoning across multiple camera wearers, with EgoMAS as a shared-memory retrieval baseline.
2026-kim-ma-egoqa.spotlightReason: Directly asks whether an answer requires evidence distributed across wearers. A useful design and evaluation reference for shared team memory, beyond independent personal archives.

2026-xiao-myego.summary: MyEgo tests whether video models connect objects, actions and earlier observations to the correct camera wearer instead of another person or a similar item.

2026-liu-egoexomem.summary: EgoExoMem tests complementary ego/exo evidence, while E²-Select allocates a limited frame budget across views according to the question.

2025-liu-visualsync.summary: Estimates globally consistent camera time offsets from cross-view tracks of moving points.

2026-long-m3-agent.summary: M3-Agent links audio-visual events and inferred knowledge to persistent person identities, then learns iterative memory retrieval for long-video question answering.

2026-ren-geb.summary: Grounded Entity Biographies (GEB) connects visually associated encounters of the same physical object or person to their surrounding events and source evidence.

2025-plizzari-osnom.summary: OSNOM evaluates persistent 3D tracking of manipulated objects, and its Lift, Match and Keep baseline retains their locations when they leave the camera view.

2026-chaudhari-ledger.summary: LEDGER stores object identities, 3D locations, histories, and descriptions so later questions can use persistent memory without replaying video.

2026-steenbergen-hoist-case-identifiers.summary: Tests how alternative event-grouping rules change estimated hoist utilization and discovered process structure when native ride identifiers are absent.

2025-chen-gelm.summary: GeLM links answer phrases to multiple supporting video intervals, with MultiHop-EgoQA measuring both answer quality and temporal evidence localization.

2026-wang-s-ember.summary: Evaluates whether an answer about earlier wearable video is both correct and supported by a localized evidence interval.
2026-wang-s-ember.spotlightReason: Makes the evidence interval part of success. Strong choice for testing whether a plausible answer can be traced back to the right video moment.

2026-kriz-multivent-raw.summary: MultiVENT-Raw evaluates event retrieval and report generation from multiple source videos, with separate checks for information coverage and supporting citations.
2026-kriz-multivent-raw.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/evidence.md — MultiVENT-Raw: retrieval quality and report support diverge

2025-yoon-uvqa.summary: Studies whether Video-LLMs can recognize questions unsupported by a supplied video, and trains refusal behavior using synthetic negative questions.

2026-pang-egoprobe.summary: Tests whether streaming video memories bind a recalled detail to the correct event when similar events recur.

2026-forte-egostream.summary: Diagnoses which facts survive streaming memory compression and how answer validity changes the interpretation of recall.

2026-alam-supermemory-vqa.summary: Evaluates practical wearable-memory questions with explicit unanswerability and distinctions between precise and vague answers.

2026-zhou-temporal-abstention.summary: Studies learned abstention in temporal text QA through reasoning supervision and abstention-aware reinforcement learning.

2025-ortiz-abstention-knobs.summary: Tests confidence-threshold risk–coverage trade-offs and their sensitivity to reduced visual evidence.

2022-soucek-look-for-change.summary: Look for the Change jointly localizes initial states, modifying actions, and final states in untrimmed web videos using temporal ordering and a few exemplar images.

2024-xue-vidosc.summary: VidOSC learns temporal stages of object transformations from language-derived pseudo-labels and transfers them to unfamiliar object–transformation combinations.

2025-zameni-moscato.summary: MOSCATO jointly models action segments and the evolving states of multiple objects throughout an egocentric procedure.

2025-schoonbeek-storm-psr.summary: STORM-PSR combines assembly-state detection with temporal completion recognition to identify correctly finished procedure steps despite partial occlusion.

2026-wen-provia.summary: PROVIA separates observed actions from accepted procedure progress to detect mistakes online and evaluates alarms across complete executions.
2026-wen-provia.spotlightReason: Evaluates complete executions, recoveries and false alarms, with timing-only controls. A useful protocol for assessing whether quality alerts remain trustworthy throughout a task.

2026-mandikal-spoc.summary: SPOC segments object regions that still need transformation versus regions already transformed, enabling spatial estimates of activity progress.

2025-perrett-hd-epic.summary: Provides densely interconnected egocentric annotations linking recipes, actions, audio, object movement, gaze and 3D scene locations.

2026-guo-procobject.summary: ProcObject-10K evaluates object-centered procedural questions with temporal evidence and adds object-supervised fine-tuning.

2025-lehman-statediffnet.summary: StateDiffNet localizes visible assembly-state differences against an intended correct reference instead of classifying a fixed list of errors.

2026-yang-egotsr.summary: EgoTSR++ learns to compare two visual states against a task goal, testing whether its judgment survives swapped inputs, regressions and recovery.

2024-nguyen-oscar.summary: OSCaR creates language supervision and benchmarks for describing object states, explaining their changes, and answering questions about egocentric interactions.

2025-sun-tubeletgraph.summary: TubeletGraph recovers object fragments missed by tracking and connects their masks, transformation timestamps and descriptions in a state graph.

2026-liang-robometer.summary: Robometer combines progress prediction with trajectory comparisons to learn from successful and failed behavior and support robot policy improvement.

2026-guo-aem.summary: AEM learns action-effect representations to detect procedural mistakes from egocentric video without running its external effect-labeling models at inference.
2026-guo-aem.spotlightReason: Represents action effects as well as action identity. The most useful quality-model hypothesis here is to test what changed in the object, with task-specific correct executions as supervision.

2024-lee-egoper.summary: The paper introduces the EgoPER cooking-error dataset and EgoPED, an offline detector that learns normal step prototypes and flags deviations during task execution.

2026-seminara-tgml.summary: TGML learns explicit task graphs from observed action sequences and reuses their prerequisite structure for procedural reasoning and online mistake detection.

2026-majumder-mistexit.summary: MistExit learns when to stop observing a pre-segmented procedural step and issue a correctness prediction.

2025-patsch-mistsense.summary: MistSense combines RGB and hand-motion features to detect procedural and execution errors online, then generates a textual explanation when a detector threshold is crossed.

2025-chavan-indego.summary: IndEgo provides multimodal industrial-work recordings and benchmarks for mistake detection, situated reasoning, and understanding two workers collaborating on a task.
2025-chavan-indego.spotlightReason: Closest dataset to our work setting: mobile industrial tasks, collaborating wearers, task graphs and mistake annotations. A better starting point for industrial evaluation than household QA alone.

2026-wen-impact.summary: IMPACT jointly annotates component state, procedural steps, anomalies, and recovery across synchronized views of commercial-tool assembly.

2025-haneji-egooops.summary: EgoOops tests whether procedural text enables localization and classification of execution mistakes in untrimmed egocentric recordings.

2026-li-egoerrorvqa.summary: EgoErrorVQA evaluates procedural error comprehension and separates procedural matching, visual narration, and error classification in Ego-ADR.

2026-sasaki-egoindassembly.summary: EgoIndAssembly stresses temporal localization of visually similar assembly steps and introduces progressive procedure grounding as a baseline.

2026-chavan-indego-assistant.summary: IndEgo Assistant turns narrated expert demonstrations into human-validated procedure graphs and video representations for recognizing steps and recommending what comes next.

2026-loginova-prism.summary: Diagnoses completed-procedure mistakes through language-grounded step sequences, with controls separating representation and decoding effects.

2026-li-matt.summary: MATT attributes instruction–video mismatches to semantic roles, a reference moment, and a spatial region using synthetic supervision from existing egocentric datasets.

2025-huang-amnar.summary: AMNAR detects execution errors by comparing the observed action with context-adapted representations of multiple valid next actions.

2026-gupta-vidparse.summary: VidParse combines frozen hand–object features, similarity-based boundaries, and task-graph constraints to parse egocentric procedures without gradient updates.

2022-jia-egotaskqa.summary: EgoTaskQA turns annotated object states, action dependencies and actor–helper interactions into diagnostic questions about goal-directed physical tasks.

2024-schoonbeek-industreal.summary: IndustReal distinguishes recognizing an action from recognizing the correct completion of a procedure step through assembly-state evidence.

2023-wang-holoassist.summary: HoloAssist records human instructors helping task performers and benchmarks mistake recognition and intervention prediction from egocentric observations.

2024-peddi-captaincook4d.summary: CaptainCook4D supplies procedural videos with explicit execution and ordering errors for step-level error recognition, localization and procedure learning.

2024-seminara-dtgl.summary: DTGL learns task dependencies for procedural reasoning and online mistake detection. It is the historical predecessor of TGML, whose later results are discussed separately in the review.
2024-seminara-dtgl.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/procedures.md — DTGL / TGML: a procedure as a dependency graph

2026-zeng-onestreamer.summary: OneStreamer jointly learns to record factual video memories and respond when enough evidence has arrived.

2025-di-rekv.summary: Separates streaming video encoding from later questions by retaining and retrieving model-specific video KV caches without additional training.

2026-liao-proactegomem.summary: ProactEgoMem tests whether an assistant acquires useful memory at the right time and maintains it through an event's lifecycle.

2026-zhang-streamarena.summary: StreamArena evaluates persistent streaming-video assistants, while StreamMind separates immediate interaction from memory construction and retrieval.

2025-bhattacharyya-livemamba.summary: LiveMamba combines a recurrent video-language assistant with a benchmark for timed instructions, completion recognition, and mistake feedback.

2026-liu-guideme.summary: GuideMe benchmarks when and how a video assistant should instruct, acknowledge completion, detect mistakes, or offer corrective guidance.

2026-panpatil-egosafetybench.summary: EgoSafetyBench separates missed hazards, unnecessary intervention, alarm timing, and susceptibility to misleading visible text.

2025-zeng-streamforest.summary: Combines a detailed recent window with event-tree compression to answer questions from bounded streaming visual memory.

2009-golparvar-fard-d4ar.summary: D4AR reconstructs camera poses and a sparse 3D scene from site photographs, then aligns the result with BIM and the construction schedule.

2026-hsieh-ai-bim-progress.summary: Maps multi-camera construction-phase detections to named BIM components and visualizes their progress against a schedule.

2026-isaac-sensing-scheduling.summary: Separates sensed execution from formal acceptance and translates measured work into schedule deviations and recovery targets.

2026-qiu-graphrag-compliance.summary: Aligns video-derived activities with regulatory rules in two knowledge graphs, then iteratively retrieves evidence to answer construction-compliance questions.

2026-zhang-constructai.summary: Describes a deployed construction-safety workflow linking camera observations, localized violations, corrective requirements and confirmation of rectification.

2025-guo-egoconqs.summary: EgoConQS studies retrieval of key construction activities for quality supervision. The review only verified bibliographic metadata and the abstract because the original full PDF was unavailable.
2025-guo-egoconqs.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/construction.md — EgoConQS, 2025: finding a key construction operation for review

2025-liu-egosafe.summary: Liu et al.’s EgoSafe studies static hazardous-object detection from egocentric construction-site footage. The review did not obtain the original full PDF and does not verify the architecture or results.
2025-liu-egosafe.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/construction.md — EgoSafe, 2025: a narrow detector of observable hazardous objects

2018-doughty-skill-ranking.summary: A Siamese video model learns relative skill scores from pairwise judgments and ranks complete demonstrations of the same task.

2026-braun-skillspotter.summary: SkillSpotter combines video features and body pose to locate moments of skilled activity and label them as good execution or needing improvement.
2026-braun-skillspotter.spotlightReason: Separates finding a feedback-worthy moment from grading it. A concrete starting point for selecting clips for human review instead of producing an unexplained overall skill score.

2025-ashutosh-expertaf.summary: ExpertAF learns to turn a learner's video and body pose into corrective commentary, a retrieved expert demonstration, and a generated expert pose sequence.

2026-mazzamuto-proskill.summary: ProSkill converts human comparisons of procedural video clips into action-specific skill rankings and benchmarks models that predict them.

2024-wu-ovvad.summary: OVVAD extends anomaly localization to naming anomaly classes absent from the training videos using visual-language alignment and generated examples.

2025-li-anomize.summary: Anomize combines static visual concepts and temporal label-aligned features to detect and classify unfamiliar anomaly categories.

2025-ye-vera.summary: VERA learns verbal diagnostic questions from weak video labels while keeping the vision-language model weights frozen.

2026-guo-multimodal-memory-survey.summary: Organizes multimodal memory by representation and management policy, with guidance on provenance, temporal validity and lifecycle evaluation.

2026-bacharidis-mistake-survey.summary: This survey organizes procedural mistake analysis by error type, temporal task, procedural structure, supervision, and evaluation protocol.

2023-mangalam-egoschema.summary: EgoSchema evaluates multiple-choice understanding of approximately three-minute egocentric videos. The relevant video is already supplied, so accuracy does not measure corpus retrieval.
2023-mangalam-egoschema.summarySource: literature-review/content/en/chapters/archive.md — Benchmarks for reading a selected video

2017-christiano-human-preferences.summary: A learned reward model turns human comparisons of short behavior clips into a training signal for deep reinforcement learning.

2017-zhang-videostorm.summary: VideoStorm jointly schedules live analytics by output quality, resource demand and tolerated processing lag.

2018-jiang-chameleon.summary: Chameleon reduces configuration-search overhead by sharing useful settings over time and across related camera streams.

2023-ma-vip.summary: VIP learns reusable visual representations and goal-image rewards from passive human video, then uses them for robot control without adapting the encoder.

2024-chen-videollm-online.summary: VideoLLM-online trains a video language model to alternate between silent visual ingestion and temporally aligned language responses.

2024-eyzaguirre-sdqes.summary: SDQES turns a natural-language event description into a standing detector that must identify the event onset causally.

2024-rodin-easg.summary: Egocentric Action Scene Graphs represent actions, participating objects, relations and persistent object identity as a temporally evolving graph.

2024-shen-protas.summary: ProTAS uses estimated within-action progress and learned task dependencies to stabilize causal action segmentation.

2024-zanella-lavad.summary: LAVAD turns pretrained captions and language-model judgments into anomaly scores without target-domain training.

2024-zhong-onlinetas.summary: OnlineTAS combines adaptive temporal memory, causal segmentation and duration-aware post-processing to label procedural actions as video arrives.

2024-zhou-streaming-dvc.summary: Streaming Dense Video Captioning compresses visual history into fixed-size memory and emits timestamped descriptions of completed events before the video ends.

2025-ahmad-sh17.summary: SH17 provides annotated workplace images and detector baselines covering body parts and PPE, including hands and gloves.

2025-ayalew-progressor.summary: PROGRESSOR learns visual progress rewards from demonstrations and tests their use in simulated online RL and human-video-pretrained robot imitation.

2025-chan-domain-vlm.summary: Adapts a vision-language model to work-at-height rules and connects sampled camera frames to alerts and indexed incident records.

2025-chen-clip2safety.summary: Clip2Safety combines scene recognition, object crops, and image–text matching to check PPE presence and attributes across workplace types.

2025-chen-diffvsgg.summary: DiffVsgg updates object–relation scene graphs causally by conditioning a latent diffusion model on earlier graph predictions.

2025-luo-hil-serl.summary: HIL-SERL combines learned success detection, demonstrations and human corrections to improve physical robot skills through online reinforcement learning.

2025-mengiste-weekly-progress.summary: Connects inspection photos and an updated schedule to an automated reporting workflow, while exposing errors in visually estimated completion.

2025-qian-dispider.summary: Dispider separates streaming perception and response decisions from an asynchronous answer generator so observation can continue during language output.

2025-wang-siteshield.summary: Pairs inspection images with spoken hazard descriptions and retrieves regulations to generate construction safety reports.

2025-zhang-holmes-vau.summary: Hierarchical anomaly instructions and anomaly-focused frame selection support explanations from clips through full videos.

2025-zhang-rewind.summary: ReWiND learns language-conditioned progress rewards from demonstrations and synthetic reversals, then uses them for offline-to-online robot policy learning.

2026-bhat-vantage-bench.summary: VANTAGE-Bench evaluates semantic, spatial and temporal understanding in operational camera views beyond ordinary video question answering.

2026-chatterjee-spot-bench.summary: SPOT-Bench evaluates every response across a continuous stream, including badly timed alerts and unnecessary speech.

2026-chen-reactvau.summary: A small anomaly detector gates expensive verification while protecting suspicious visual evidence in streaming memory.

2026-gao-svg2.summary: SVG2 scales temporal object–attribute–relation annotations and trains TraSeR to decode structured video graphs from object-aligned visual trajectories.

2026-jang-neurosymbolic-pc.summary: Refines detected construction activities with spatial, temporal and prerequisite rules, then exports activity durations and productivity records.

2026-lee-axg-reasoner.summary: AXG-Reasoner aligns action segments with learned subaction graphs to expose sparse mistakes and generate localized explanations with frozen vision–language models.

2026-lee-roboreward.summary: RoboReward turns a task instruction and robot rollout into a completion score, with benchmarks and physical policy-learning tests.

2026-li-streampro.summary: StreamPro combines class-balanced streaming supervision with multi-turn reinforcement learning to optimize response content, timing and trajectory coherence.

2026-liu-svcbench.summary: SVCBench evaluates how object and event counts evolve across a video, exposing state drift hidden by final-answer accuracy.

2026-ranasinghe-safety-reasoning.summary: The framework converts colored point-cloud streams into scene graphs, immediate rule alerts, contextual language-model assessments, and retrieved historical evidence.

2026-suen-icon-pose.summary: Introduces construction-specific egocentric pose data and classifies action sequences using predicted skeletons.

2026-tang-takusen.summary: Takusen pairs a small boundary detector with a larger captioner to separate when an event should be described from what its description should say.

2026-torne-freeform-preference.summary: FPL learns rewards along human-defined preference axes and conditions a robot policy on the desired trade-off between them.

2026-wang-parsee-vad.summary: Frozen multimodal inference acquires selected propositions and carries compact score state across causal windows.

2026-wu-monitorvlm-v2.summary: A deployed mining monitor replaces free-form reasoning with bounded rule-ID decisions and mandatory human confirmation.

2026-xia-streamo.summary: Streamo trains one model to track streaming instructions, distinguish silence from incomplete evidence and emit task-appropriate responses.

2026-yao-yolo-ilb.summary: YOLO-ILB combines a compact PPE detector with image-geometry rules for classifying safety-harness anchoring states.

2026-ye-regular.summary: RegulAR combines an instruction-derived dependency graph with periodic video observations to track procedural progress and deliver error-specific AR assistance.

2026-zhao-pasbench-video.summary: PaSBench-Video distinguishes seeing an accident from issuing a correctly grounded warning during its actionable precursor.

2026-ziadia-collision-survey.summary: This review connects construction collision-monitoring research to commercial-system capabilities and the evidence needed for reliable warnings.
